{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.06

|gr1= HashMap

|descr= Processes provided ''value''<nowiki/>'s hash, and encodes it using {{Link|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Base64|Base64}}. The hash algorithm is {{Link|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fowler%E2%80%93Noll%E2%80%93Vo_hash_function|FNV-1A 64bit}}.
{{Feature|informative|A hash value remains the same between game restarts but for [[Object]] and [[Group]] type, their hash being based on their [[netId]].}}

|s1= [[hashValue]] value

|p1= value: [[Array]], [[Boolean]], [[Code]], [[Config]], [[Group]], [[Namespace]], [[NaN]], [[Number]], [[Object]], [[Side]] or [[String]]

|r1= [[String]] - base64-encoded 64 bits hash

|x1= <sqf>private _valueHash = hashValue "Hello There";</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>private _isCorrectPW = hashValue _enteredPassword == "eWkXUUqiinE";</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>hashValue (systemTime joinString ""); // Returns a unique hash value such as "xoMQ9qd7S60"</sqf>

|seealso= [[createHashMap]] [[values]]
}}
